releaseNotes: 6.1.14 (beta): Zigbee spectrum card: the channel scan no longer counts the hub's own network; WiFi channels that overlap the hub's channel are hatched instead of red; green marks the recommended pairing, Zigbee 15/20/25 with WiFi 1/6/11; strength colours apply only to the hub's channel, other channels are listed in neutral.
